units.source_text: 陷阱利用沙子的特性，是个极其简单的东西。

en.t: The trap made use of the properties of sand and was an extremely simple device.

units.source_text: 先挖一个较深的洞，在洞的底部埋上一个木桶，

en.t: First, a fairly deep hole was dug, and a wooden barrel was buried at the bottom of it,

units.source_text: 用火柴棍粗细的木楔子在三处固定住木桶的盖子，

en.t: then the barrel lid was fixed in three places with wooden wedges as thick as matchsticks,

units.source_text: 每根木楔子都拴上一根细绳，细绳穿过盖子中心的孔，同外面的铁丝相连。

en.t: A thin cord was tied to each wooden wedge, and the cords passed through a hole in the center of the lid and connected to a wire outside.

units.source_text: 铁丝的尖头上，吊着作诱饵的干鱼。

en.t: A dried fish used as bait hung from the pointed end of the wire.

units.source_text: 然后，慎重地用沙子掩盖起来，从外面看起来，沙插钵的底部里，只能看到诱饵。

en.t: Then it was carefully covered with sand, so that from the outside, at the bottom of the sand funnel, only the bait could be seen.

units.source_text: 乌鸦去叼诱饵，楔子立刻脱落，盖子掉下来，

en.t: When a crow went to seize the bait, the wedges would immediately come loose and the lid would fall,

units.source_text: 同时周围的沙子一起坍塌，乌鸦就被严严实实地活埋了……

en.t: and at the same time the surrounding sand would collapse with it, burying the crow alive without a gap left open...

units.source_text: 做了两三次实验，无可挑剔……

en.t: After two or three experiments, it was beyond reproach...

units.source_text: 他的眼前似乎出现了乌鸦的身影：

en.t: The image of the crow seemed to appear before his eyes:

units.source_text: 在陷阱里连扑棱翅膀的时间都没有，就被沙子哧溜哧溜地吸了进去。

en.t: inside the trap, without even time to flap its wings, it was sucked smoothly down into the sand.
